[shortest loops in a homotopy class]

Source: petersen:page-0285 1. ch6:6.7.16Let $(M,g)$ be complete. Show every element of $\pi _1(M,p)$ contains a shortest loop at $p$, and that this shortest loop is a geodesic loop.
